speaker: consultant
text: Good afternoon, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Hi Elena, it is Patrick Doyle. I am calling to cancel my retainer.

speaker: consultant
text: I am sorry to hear that, Patrick. Can I ask what made you decide?

speaker: customer
text: Honestly, I expected more. We have had eight sessions, and our sales are exactly where they were.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand that is frustrating. We did change the pricing only last month, so the effect may not show yet.

speaker: customer
text: Maybe. But I cannot keep paying six hundred dollars a month and hope.

speaker: consultant
text: That is completely fair. Would a shorter plan help, for example one more month focused only on sales?

speaker: customer
text: No. I have made up my mind. I just want to know how the cancellation works.

speaker: consultant
text: The retainer has a thirty day notice period. If you cancel today, your last month ends on the fourteenth of next month.

speaker: customer
text: And this month? I paid on the first.

speaker: consultant
text: The current month is not refunded, but you still have one session and email support until the notice period ends.

speaker: customer
text: So I pay for another month I don't want. Great.

speaker: consultant
text: I know it is not what you hoped to hear. It is in the agreement, and it is the same for all clients.

speaker: customer
text: I know it is in the agreement. I am just disappointed with how this went.

speaker: consultant
text: I am sorry it did not work out the way you wanted. I will send you the written cancellation confirmation today.

speaker: customer
text: Fine. Please cancel the last session too. I won't use it.

speaker: consultant
text: Understood. I will confirm everything by email.
